levels.name: OceanLab
levels.blocker: BODY model model2 -- world Model2.points holds a 2-ULP-off value pair native/UED22 disagree on (same array length, 3776=3776, so a value divergence not a reordering). Real effort spent, root cause NOT found: ruled out the brush483/brush1423 transform, a direct FLinePlaneIntersection crossing against the obvious x=-256 plane, and every split_with_plane crossing near that point (~5500 live-instrumented hits, none matched). Likely a different point-pooling/insertion-order gap from the already-fixed MergeNearPoints/pBase class -- needs the same live-editor-probe effort (winedbg) that produced today's other breakthroughs. No exclusion proposed.

levels.name: WanChai Market
levels.blocker: N=58: leaf 51 gets an extra permeating-light entry -- same shape as N=45 but a DIFFERENT cause: the crossing itself is fine, what differs is the beam polygon carried into the leaf. N=45's real bug is FIXED (BREAKTHROUGH): FPoly::SplitWithPlaneFast's crossing vertex comes from FLinePlaneIntersection's exact formula (Sc = (W - dot(P1,N)) / dot(D,N); out = Sc*D + P1), not native's mathematically-equivalent alpha = dp/(dp-ds) -- same real number, different f32 rounding, which on WanChai collapsed a downstream clip edge to zero length and let a beam through a boundary it should have stopped at. This is the SAME root cause already fixed for Island/OceanLab/UNATCO's shared leaf-permeating class -- WanChai N=45 was its cheapest reproducer.
